name: THE HELL PROVIDED
source:
Every day is the same.

The weight of your duty grinds you down.

You live for life's sake.

When does it end?

[From [url=https://howling-angel-games.itch.io/the-hell-provided]itch.io[/url]]

每一天都是一样的。
